ANNOUNCEMENT.icon: dark green megaphone on ivory tile

body_layout.wrapping: Conservative glyph estimates, word wrapping and long token splitting. Reject over limit content rather than clipping.

rendering_rules: Each flair has its own supplied vector composition and exact palette.
The outer frame and canvas height are derived from the final wrapped body line.
The SVG has explicit intrinsic width and height with a matching viewBox so server rasterization is deterministic.
No gradients, raster images, external dependencies, filters, transparency or clipping masks.
All user supplied text is XML escaped.
